entities.name: Mieczysław Krąpiec
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mieczysław Albert Maria Krąpiec OP was a Polish Thomist philosopher, theologian and rector of John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin between 1970 and 1983. Krąpiec was a founder of the Lublin school of Thomism.

entities.summary: Mieczysław Albert Maria Krąpiec OP was a Polish Thomist philosopher, theologian and rector of John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin between 1970 and 1983. Krąpiec was a founder of the Lublin school of Thomism.
